title: Choosing Your ITR Form: ITR-1, ITR-2, or ITR-4?
description: Selecting the correct Income Tax Return (ITR) form is crucial for accurate tax filing and avoiding penalties. ITR-1 (Sahaj) is for individuals with simple inc.

faq.q: What happens if I file the wrong ITR form?
faq.a: If you file an incorrect ITR form, the Income Tax Department may treat your return as "defective". You will receive a notice under Section 139(9) of the Income Tax Act, asking you to rectify the defect by filing a revised return with the correct form. Failure to do so within the specified timeframe can lead to your return being treated as not filed.

faq.q: Can NRIs use ITR-1 or ITR-4?
faq.a: No, Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) are specifically excluded from using ITR-1 (Sahaj) and ITR-4 (Sugam). NRIs typically need to file ITR-2 if they don't have business income, or ITR-3 if they do.

Presumptive taxation is a scheme under the Income Tax Act that allows eligible small businesses and professionals to declare income at a prescribed percentage of their gross receipts or turnover, without maintaining detailed books of accounts. This simplifies compliance for them.

faq.q: I have both salary and capital gains. Which form should I use?
faq.a: If you have both salary income and income from capital gains, you cannot use ITR-1 or ITR-4. You would typically need to file ITR-2, provided you do not have income from a business or profession.

faq.q: What if I have foreign assets or foreign income?
faq.a: If you are a resident individual and have foreign assets or any income from a source outside India, you are not eligible to file ITR-1 or ITR-4. You would generally need to file ITR-2 (if no business income) or ITR-3 (if you have business income).

faq.q: What is the deadline for filing ITR-1, ITR-2, and ITR-4?
faq.a: For most individual taxpayers, including those filing ITR-1, ITR-2, and ITR-4, the deadline for filing income tax returns for FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27) is typically July 31st of the assessment year. However, it is always advisable to check the official Income Tax Department website (incometax.gov.in) for any specific notifications or changes to deadlines.
